_what_this_is: the maintainer decision permitting ONE Phase-C2 Search-1 launcher session -- attempt 1. An INPUT to the issuer, which derives every identity from the committed objects and REFUSES a grant that asserts one. It authorizes nothing by itself: no pod, no authorization, no spend.
_where_this_lives: inside its own run, at logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c2/runs/attempt1/governance/grant.json, because a grant is a fact about one attempt and needs an owner. Runs are grouped by the stage their experiment declares; Phase C2 declares stage 1, projection and structural initialization.
granted_for: Phase C2 Search-1 -- ATTENTION-aware composition/order re-search, attempt 1
granted_by: the EXPLICIT MAINTAINER APPROVAL of 2026-09-15, given against the independently reviewed execution package at commit 7d0a35af1c4b5d5b5b7fb157c96dd25efa4f1df6. The approval states its own scope and its own ceiling and forbids substituting C1's $15.1475 per-session figure.
covers: exactly ONE Phase-C2 Search-1 launcher session at a hard ceiling of $15.0446: one beam search over the frozen four-operator Search-1 space under SCHEDULE_V1 (beam width 6, one warmup level), ATTENTION fixed to attention.activation_importance_v1 branching over the two declared profiles, DEPTH/FFN/RESIDUAL_WIDTH held at their declared profiles, operator order free; plus, CONDITIONALLY, exactly one rebuild of the frozen C1 baseline B when the deterministic rule finds the beam did not re-derive it; plus the required c2_baseline_comparison.json B->C search-stage evidence. Nothing in the space, the schedule, the profiles, the B identity contract or the pricing semantics may move.
explicitly_not_authorized: any behavioural confirmation of B vs C
any C1 rerun, reseeding or battery change
a second formal Search-1 execution after the beam search has begun

one_use.what_that_means: this authorization funds ONE launcher session. Inside it the launcher may replace a host that never became usable, up to three draws, all sharing this session's single $15.0446 ceiling. It may never have two resources billing at once: SessionRunner.release_and_confirm requires the PROVIDER to report an abandoned pod not billing before the next is created, and aborts the session if that cannot be confirmed.
one_use.consumed_when: the formal launcher is invoked under this authorization, whether or not a provider resource follows and whether or not any money is spent.
one_use.retry_rule: ordinary engineering failures BEFORE the beam search begins may be diagnosed and repaired under AGENTS.md P12.1 inside this ceiling, with a fresh chain and a new attempt identity. Once the beam search has begun, a failure is NOT retried: preserve evidence, tear down, reconcile spend and return to the maintainer. A formal experiment retry needs a new maintainer decision.

bound_identities_the_issuer_must_reprodu._rule: stated here as the maintainer's approval basis and RE-DERIVED by the issuer from the committed objects. The issuer refuses if any of them disagrees; a grant that asserts an identity it did not compute is not evidence of anything.

approved_money._ceiling_rule: $15.0446 is the MAXIMUM authorization for this session. The maintainer forbids rounding it upward and forbids substituting C1's $15.1475 per-session ceiling, which belongs to a different package and a different experiment.
approved_money.price_rule: the live L40S securePrice must be re-queried immediately before provider creation. ABOVE $1.09/h the session STOPS at $0 and returns for a new maintainer budget decision; the ceiling is not enlarged automatically.

approved_runtime_envelopes._beam_rule: the DEPTH-early base plus beam_composition_risk and NOTHING else. It excludes the baseline rebuild reserve, which is not the beam's to spend.
approved_runtime_envelopes._baseline_rule: conditional, on its own clock, started only if the deterministic rule establishes B is absent.
approved_runtime_envelopes._recovery_rule: reachable by neither the search nor the rebuild. Scientific work may not intentionally consume it.

budget_context_at_approval._source: logs/budget/ledger.md; restated by the maintainer in the approval

interpretation_discipline: the Search-1 state_eval result is HYPOTHESIS-GENERATION evidence only. It is not behavioural recovery evidence and must not be described as a demonstrated student capability improvement. C1 remains closed and frozen.
stop_conditions: the beam search has begun and anything fails -- preserve, tear down, reconcile, report
a repair would change the C2 harness, the search plan, the scientific space, the B identity contract or the pricing semantics -- stop and return for review
Search-1 completes with any outcome -- stop after evidence collection and provider-confirmed teardown
authorizes: nothing by itself; it is the input the issuer requires
